title: Microsoft Purview DLP: aggregate alerts by user (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing accurately separates the government-cloud roadmap plan from Learn's related preview and does not invent a default or aggregation command. The documented rule-level alert controls are supported. One minor gap remains: the rollout checklist refers to tenant-level aggregation controls that are not in the controls table.

claims.claim: User-based aggregation modifies single-event alerts by grouping their events by user.
claims.quote: In preview, single-event alerts can be aggregated on per rule per user basis. This is called user and rule-based alert aggregation.

claims.claim: The preview's configurable aggregation windows are 15, 30, 45 and 60 minutes.
claims.quote: The rule match events must occur within the configurable time window (15, 30, 45 and 60 minutes).

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn's preview generates alerts per rule match event per user rather than documenting cross-rule consolidation.
claims.quote: Alerts are generated per rule match event per user.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify which roadmap item or government cloud the related preview applies to.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview user based alert aggregation GCC GCC High DoD default enabled tenant settings portal; read dlp-alerts-get-started, GCC and GCC High planning pages and DoD planning search excerpt; none ties the preview to these clouds or roadmap ids.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Learn warns that per-user aggregation can increase alert volume.
claims.quote: For single user per rule. - Expect an increase in alert volume.

claims.claim: The comparison baseline groups multiple users' matches into an alert for one rule.
claims.quote: User based alert aggregation is set to Off at the tenant level. ... Aggregate DLP rule matches of multiple users into one alert.

claims.quote: file path | the absolute path of the item involved with the DLP policy match | SharePoint, OneDrive, and devices events

claims.claim: DLP alert events can carry email recipients.
claims.quote: email recipients | if an email was the sensitive item that matched the DLP policy, this field includes the recipients of that email | Exchange events

claims.claim: DLP alert events can carry email subjects.
claims.quote: email subject | subject of the email that matched the DLP policy | Exchange events

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A new match for the same user and rule within the aggregation window is added to the same alert even if it has been closed.
claims.quote: If the alert is closed within the aggregation time window and a new match occurs for the same user and rule, then the new rule match will be aggregated into the same alert.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes grouping alert events and does not describe new automated actions or changes to DLP detection.
claims.quote: This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: User-based aggregation does not apply to threshold-based aggregation.
claims.quote: Threshold based aggregation - Aggregate DLP rule matches based on count of matches. - User based alert aggregation not applicable.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Alerts may take up to 3 hours to be generated after configuring or modifying DLP policy alerts.
claims.quote: It may take up to 3 hours to generate alerts after you configure or modify existing alerts in a DLP policy.
